clean_native_browser_commands.summary: Clean harness retained passive focus observation and strict Ctrl+F/three-match assertions; address, back, next, reload, Find and close passed. Focus events include focusin on content-search-input. Initial x64 harness bootstrap errors are preserved separately and did not reach the fixture. This run does not prove the cause of the earlier intermittent focus loss.

preserved_failures_and_limits: The initial VM probe fixture path failures are preserved, though superseded by successful corrected retries.

Earlier intermittent x64 Find focus loss remains causally unexplained; this gate and the clean focused harness passed, but do not establish why the earlier loss occurred. A recent fallback/focus-area correction has four pre-archive passes.
Authenticated browser actions and authenticated external service behavior remain unverified because account credentials/services were unavailable.
A real managing-host event stream and stable reconnect identity are external inputs and remain unverified.
The original verification service is Darwin-gated and has no normal Linux caller; no Linux approval response was invented or bypassed.
Automatic approval review rejected broadening NODE_REPL_TRUSTED_CODE_PATHS to all of CODEX_HOME. The narrower trust roots remain; no bypass was made.
Concurrent clipboard isolation and actual native socket connect-timeout expiration were not covered.
These local gates do not establish universal behavioral identity, agent reliability, or release readiness.
